column2: the planned collapse of the step 5 mav/coder shared blockquote lists checks-failed macro tokens and stall handoff but drops the load-bearing checks-pass success continuation (`on checks pass, apply the composite stdout parsing slice and full resume envelope contract below`). without it, the post-checks `checks-step5-resume` success path breaks and `test-implement-relevant-checks-anti-halt.sh` `has_success` fails (it requires `checks pass`, `next_action=continue`, or `relevant_checks_skipped=true` within five lines before `checks-step5-resume`).

the plan collapses the preflight exit-code-3 sub-cases out of `skills/implement/skill.md` into a one-line pointer, but `scripts/test-plan-adequacy-audit.sh` line 92 still asserts `state=awaiting-response` against `$skill`. the authoritative state detail lives in `skills/implement/references/preflight-plan-audit.md`; after the rewrite the harness fails and stops verifying the reachable source of truth.
